title: ComputeTriptych
description: Source of truth: computed projection over system_metrics (free/used — Category C operational from infrastructure:system-sample observations) and rea_commitments (stewarded — Category A notarized custody-blob commitments). Reconstructed per request; not persisted.

free.description: Bytes available on device blob filesystem (capacity - used)

used.description: Bytes occupied by blob storage on device

stewarded.description: Bytes committed via rea_commitments where this peer is provider (action=custody-blob)
